question: Should maintainers land this compatibility-sensitive skipped-preview output contract for Gateway policy repairs now, or require additional packaged CLI rendering proof first?
rationale: The code review found no line-level defect and discussion records acceptance of the review-required boundary, but the PR intentionally changes operator-visible doctor output for security-sensitive Gateway config findings and carries a protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Land accepted preview boundary

options.title: Hold for preview stack review
